author: reek
body: H6: the user-visible surface for the trust system. Lists the publishers known to the local TrustLattice with their scores, supports adjusting the read-time trust threshold (the H3 dial), and lets the user maintain an explicit blocklist that suppresses below-threshold annotations even if they would otherwise pass.

author: reek
body: Build a PublisherEntry list by walking the TrustLattice's entries HAMT and combining each agent's trust score with its blocklist status. Pure read -- does not mutate the lattice.

author: reek
body: Re-derive the publishers field from the current lattice. Call after the user blocks/unblocks or after the lattice changes.

author: reek
body: An identity passes the filter only if its trust-score >= threshold AND it is not on the blocklist. Used by H3's downstream caller to augment the simple-threshold check with the explicit blocklist.

author: reek
body: Build the widget tree for the explorer overlay. Top-level helpers return single rows so the list literal in the panel body stays free of inline `when` (which is the parser's sore spot, see KNOWN-CONDITIONS / Parser).
